name: Taputapuātea
description: Taputapuātea sits on Ra'iātea in French Polynesia, at the heart of the vast Polynesian Triangle in the Pacific. Its stone marae, open-air platforms and courts, once served as a political, ceremonial and funerary centre where the living met their ancestors and gods. The protected area also takes in two forested valleys, a lagoon and reef, and a strip of open ocean, reflecting 1,000 years of mā'ohi civilization.
